check_items: After HM search, run a separate QA/Low pass over raw balances, dust recovery, refund addresses, zero amount handling, and donation leftovers.
For every blocked/default message library, compare advertised interface/capability flags with implemented callable functions.
Search codec helpers for Address, payload hash, nonce, DVN option, and sentinel serialization; assert round-trip tests keep tags and reject nil sentinels when relevant.
Review custom-to-default library cutover and grace-window semantics separately from active receive/send library overwrite leads.
Check worker/admin/signer vectors for caps, batched rotation, duplicate entries, zero admins, and high-s/v signature edge cases.
Compare quote/get_fee outputs with assign_job/payment paths and verify no amount drift is silently accepted.
Sweep pagination u32 casts, i128 sums/multiplications, and zero treasury amounts for QA/Low or escalation conditions.
core_invariants: Fee/refund logic should use explicit call-local amounts, not ambient raw balances, unless residual ownership is documented.
Library capability metadata should match implemented send/receive behavior.
Cross-chain codecs should preserve security-relevant type tags and sentinel values.
Default/custom library and config inheritance should not silently change message safety assumptions.
Admin, worker, signer, and DVN vectors should remain bounded and operationally recoverable.
description: Checklist for the post-HM QA/Low harvest phase in Rust/Soroban endpoint and cross-chain message-library repositories, derived from the LayerZero Stellar Endpoint public-report gap review.
test_ideas: Construct residual balance before send and assert exact call-local fee/refund accounting.
Instantiate blocked libraries and assert advertised capability flags match failing/succeeding entrypoints.
Round-trip account and contract Address variants through payload encoding.
Run one fuzz/table test for duplicate DVN/admin/worker Vec entries and zero-length vectors.
trust_boundaries: Endpoint contract raw native balance vs per-call fee funding.
OApp-selected library config vs endpoint default library config.
Worker/DVN/admin controlled paths vs permissionless send/receive paths.
Soroban Address account/contract variants vs cross-chain byte payloads.
